rules: Historical phase names remain only as evidence identifiers.
New work must have a stable capability ID, falsifiable gate, hard resource budget, baselines, metamorphic tests, and explicit claim boundary.
Task-specific score gains do not count unless the same learned mechanism transfers across held-out entities, compositions, or domains.
A downstream capability must preserve every dependency declared frozen; relearning a dependency disqualifies promotion even when task accuracy is perfect.
CAP-SEM micro-gates are frozen from the critical path until one frozen checkpoint improves multiple unrelated public axes.
Three major architecture iterations with less than fifteen aggregate percentage points of CAP-GEN-001 improvement require abandonment of the current core architecture.
Any axis that remains at zero after two major iterations requires a shared-representation or learning-objective change rather than another local solver.

capabilities.name: leave-one-domain-out statistical transfer
capabilities.boundary: positive for code and prose; negative for structured data

capabilities.name: weakly supervised relational meaning invariance
capabilities.boundary: tokenized controlled clauses; not unrestricted Japanese understanding

capabilities.name: raw controlled-Japanese clause and argument grounding
capabilities.boundary: finite controlled Japanese grammar; inherited closed relation vocabulary

capabilities.name: opaque relation-expression grounding into frozen semantics
capabilities.boundary: complete controlled behavioral contrast set; not natural-language definition understanding

capabilities.name: sparse noisy definition and ordinary-usage induction
capabilities.boundary: controlled synthetic definitions and usages; every term still maps into one of four existing latent relation codes

capabilities.name: data-driven ontology expansion with a new inverse relation pair
capabilities.boundary: new ontology pair uses the same directed transitive graph algebra; not arbitrary concept formation

capabilities.name: single-checkpoint integrated public reality baseline
capabilities.boundary: public reasoning proxy only; insufficient for Japanese high-school intelligence or strong-LLM parity
